slides.title: What you proved
slides.body:
Circuit drops. Secondary path
takes over in under a second.
Routing table exactly right.

slides.title: The connection pool
slides.body:
Holding sessions to an address
that no longer answers.
Won't retry for four minutes.

slides.title: DNS
slides.body:
Handing out a cached record
with a ten-minute TTL.

slides.title: The health check
slides.body:
Passes. It only tests whether
the process is *alive*.

slides.title: The licensing server
slides.body:
Nobody remembers it. Reachable
from the primary path —
*not the secondary*.

slides.title: The uncomfortable part
slides.body:
None of it is a network fault.
All of it is *your outage*.

slides.title: Test the whole path
steps: Fail the link, then run a real transaction.
Time until it *works* — not until the route appears.
Write down every dependency you find.

slides.title:
Resilience without
dependency mapping
slides.body:
Is a rehearsal for
*half the play*.

Follow *@mzsnetworks*
